item.title: How My OPNsense Firewall Is Set Up
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: An overview of my network segmentation in OPNsense: six VLANs with different purposes, a base rule template that repeats across them (DNS, blocking private networks, default allow), VPN split tunneling through aliases and a dedicated gateway, and a look at the point-to-point rules for each segment.
